title: Big Red Balloon
specs: Oldest and only full-time hot air balloon ride operator in West Central Florida since 1992.
Pilots are FAA-licensed and certified; lead pilot has over 3,300 flight hours.
Typical altitudes range from treetop level up to 1,000 feet or higher for steering currents.
Flight path features forests, lakes, ponds, ranch lands, and native wildlife; occasional Tampa skyline and Gulf of Mexico views.
Balloons are 118,000 cubic feet, about six stories tall when inflated.
Passengers may participate in inflating the balloon before flight.

highlights: Oldest and only full-time hot air balloon ride operator in West Central Florida since 1992.
Pilots are FAA-licensed and certified; lead pilot has over 3,300 flight hours.
Typical altitudes range from treetop level up to 1,000 feet or higher for steering currents.
Flight path features forests, lakes, ponds, ranch lands, and native wildlife; occasional Tampa skyline and Gulf of Mexico views.
Balloons are 118,000 cubic feet, about six stories tall when inflated.
Passengers may participate in inflating the balloon before flight.
requirements: Children between 6 and 10 years old may ride (special fare). Recommend age 7+ for best results.
Basket height is 48 inches; consider if child can see over edge and handle loud burner sound.
Combined passenger weight should not exceed 375 lbs. per couple or 750 lbs. per group of 4 for shared flights.
Groups of two over 400 lbs. must book a private 'Sweetheart' flight.
Infants can be accommodated if secured in a carrier worn on the body.
If pregnant, speak to your doctor before booking.
Passengers with physical limitations should call office in advance to discuss accommodations.
groupInfo: Standard shared balloon capacity is up to 4 passengers plus pilot.
Private 'Sweetheart' flight is for 2 passengers plus pilot.
Larger groups can be accommodated by arranging with other pilots. Additional fee applies.
Private events and tethers available by request.
bring: Casual dress recommended. Dress for ground temperature; layers for chilly mornings.
Wear sneakers or hiking boots. Open-toed shoes are strongly discouraged.
You may bring cameras, Go Pros, or recording equipment at your own risk.
season: Flights operate daily, sunrise only, year-round.
meetingPoint: Bob Evan’s Restaurant in the Temple Terrace area, approximately 12 miles north of downtown Tampa. Exact location provided after booking.
cancellation: Cancellations/changes more than 72 hours in advance permitted without penalty. Cancellations within 72 hours incur $75 charge or forfeiture of gift certificate. No-shows or cancellations less than 24 hours in advance: full fare due. If flight canceled due to weather, you may reschedule. No refunds for weather cancellation, only rescheduling. Operator reserves right to cancel any flight at any time for safety or compliance.
